boundary_condition: Applies only to flight departure time-of-day; it does not determine destination, date, route, arrival time, lodging timing, or transportation outside the flight search.
condition: When arranging flight itineraries and choosing a departure time of day for a flight leg, prefer evening departures if the user has not given a conflicting time requirement.
default_action: Filter or rank flight options toward departures in the evening for the relevant outbound or return leg.
exception_condition: If the user specifies a non-evening departure time, needs a departure earlier than evening, or no feasible evening flight satisfies the trip constraints, honor the stated constraint or ask whether a non-evening option is acceptable.
name: Evening flight departure default
rationale: Multiple independent flight dialogues include explicit requests for evening departures, including outbound-only and both-leg cases. The examples support a scoped synthetic default for departure time, not a universal travel preference or a claim about one real user.
